reason: Under 2.x, `openspec validate --all --strict` (gate-full.sh) fails 66 of 67 specs (302 requirements over 500 characters, 46 placeholder Purposes), and 2.x moves skill delivery to .agents/skills/, so `openspec update` would overwrite the repo's customized skills and commands.
lift: The follow-up change that migrates the spec corpus to OpenSpec 2.x validation

reason: @react-native/babel-preset and Metro (metro-transform-worker) depend on @babel/core ^7.25.2; Babel 8 is ESM-only and its presets and plugins peer @babel/core ^8.
lift: A React Native release whose babel preset and Metro support Babel 8

reason: metro-runtime depends on @babel/runtime ^7.25.0, and the helpers @babel/plugin-transform-runtime 7 injects must resolve to @babel/runtime 7; it moves with @babel/core.
lift: A React Native release whose babel preset and Metro support Babel 8

reason: TypeScript 7.0 ships no compiler API, and the server's static checker, checks/, typescript-eslint and knip import `typescript` as a library; the React Native 0.88 template pins ^6.0.3.
lift: A stable TypeScript 7.x with a compiler API that typescript-eslint supports

reason: It must match the Metro line React Native 0.88.1 resolves: react-native depends on metro-runtime and metro-source-map ^0.87.1, and @react-native/metro-config 0.88.1 on metro ^0.87.1, so metro-symbolicate 0.88 would read source maps from a Metro version the app does not run.
lift: A React Native release that moves to Metro 0.88 or newer

reason: @react-native/eslint-config 0.88.1 peers eslint ^8.0.0 || ^9.0.0 and eslint-plugin-react-native 5.0.0 (its dependency, also the latest release) peers eslint up to ^9, so ESLint 10 is outside both peer ranges. eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 (the locked version) peers eslint ^9.7 at most is a third blocker. npm marks eslint 9.39.5 deprecated ("no longer supported"), so this pin holds an end-of-life line.
